## Batch 8 authored

Completed the A/B pages, nine item carriers, manifest, coverage, proof contracts, notes, cross-batch evidence, and Step 1 records. The [A page](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/library/hopf-hecke-algebras/quasitriangular-hopf-algebras-and-braided-module-categories.md) and [examples page](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/library/hopf-hecke-algebras/quasitriangular-hopf-algebras-and-braided-module-categories-examples.md) remain draft.

Step 1 records one item `ready`—the standalone tensor-algebra detection lemma—and eight `escalated`. Those eight depend on the leg definition, whose planned HH-10 justification still has an unaudited transitive proof closure. The [cross-batch evidence](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/hopf-hecke-unfinished-15-2026-10-15-batch-8.cross-batch-dependencies.json) records the exact suppliers and affected claims. The declared HH-4/HH-6 page-level prerequisite chains also need owner reconciliation; their direct item bodies were present and checked.

## Checks and remaining owner work

Scoped proof layout, precheck, proof contracts, content policy, dependency checks, forward-reference checks, citation checks, and rendering checks passed. The two full-text sources are fetch-verified: [Kytölä’s lecture notes](https://www.math.aalto.fi/~kkytola/files_KK/lectures_files_KK/Hopf-lecture_notes.pdf) and [Etingof–Semenyakin’s notes](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2106.05252). The coverage checklist has one low-yield warning: 9 of 33 harvested results became items; the rest have recorded dispositions, with Alpha confirmation still pending.

The run-wide item-level check found no batch-8 label errors, but reported nine HH-10 level mismatches. The batch-level check also found the shared scheduling artifact stale after manifest changes; I left it for the owner to recompute. The HH-10 carrier is labeled level 13, its manifest level is 4, and the checker computes 12.

The [batch notes](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/hopf-hecke-unfinished-15-2026-10-15-batch-8.notes.md), [manifest](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/hopf-hecke-unfinished-15-2026-10-15-batch-8.pages.json), [coverage](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/hopf-hecke-unfinished-15-2026-10-15-batch-8.coverage.json), and [proof contracts](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/hopf-hecke-unfinished-15-2026-10-15-batch-8.proof-contracts.json) record the work and blockers. Kytölä’s claim that a commutative bialgebra must be cocommutative is false; the notes give a counterexample, and no batch-8 proof relies on that claim.
